title: Hearty Thai Chicken Nam Prik
description: A funky, shattering post-workout Thai chicken dish featuring a tangy nam-prik sauce with white wine vinegar and ferment-jang.
instructions: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté diced red bell pepper and julienned carrot until slightly softened, about 3 minutes.
While vegetables cook, combine soy sauce, fish sauce, white wine vinegar, fermented jang, lime juice, and honey in a bowl to make the nam-prik sauce.
Return the chicken to the skillet and pour the nam-prik sauce over the mixture.
Stir everything together and let it simmer for 4 minutes to meld flavors.
Remove from heat and stir in chopped cilantro.
Serve hot over steamed jasmine rice or cauliflower rice for a low-carb option.
Garnish with extra cilantro and a squeeze of lime if desired.
